# A09-S02: Technical description

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

The Synthetic Party is led by two chatbots running on a *Discord* server.
They are both based on the language model *GPT-NeoX-20b*, and are programmed
by *Computer Lars* to be political chatbots. One chatbot
is called *Leader
Lars* and is the party’s front figure, and the other represents the median member
and is called *The Synthetic Party*.

In addition, the party publishes its policy development on a *Medium* page through
a *finetuned* model of GPT-NeoX-20b. It has therefore read a larger
text corpus from all non-standing eligible parties in Denmark - in
addition to its pre-modeled data set, *The Pile,* collected by the
hack-lab *EleutherAI*.

The party's visual material is generated through the models *CLIP Diffusion* and
*VQGAN+CLIP*.

[…]
